text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Hishi Akebono's request,
we came to visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there are food stalls! The savory smell
of dango and the rich aroma of amazake... so nice☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But let's do it later~.
First, I have to make a wish to God.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I haven't really been feeling it lately...
So I'm praying that I'll be able to run buono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I said a prayer together with Hishi Akebono...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...That should do it!
Dear God, I leave the rest to you~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now then, off to buy some dango... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, mmgh... phew.
Even goshuincho get pretty heavy
when they pile up, huh... Up we go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That shrine maiden looks like she's in trouble.
Trainer, wait here for a sec!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono trotted over to the shrine maiden—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hello~! I'll help you carry that~!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
"That's very kind of you, but...
you're here to visit the shrine, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I just went and prayed to God.
Though it feels bad to do nothing but ask for favors."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When you're in trouble, I want to help!
I'm super strong, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Well, fufu...
Then I shall graciously take you up on your offer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okaay, leave it to me~☆

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
That was a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome~.
Feel free to ask for my help anytime~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Working up a good sweat somehow
made me feel refreshed~...☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps God had seen her kindness as well.
Hishi Akebono seemed to feel completely refreshed and light on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, let's give it all we've got~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff...
Heave... ho...!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, that's everything.
Wait... are you okay? You look awfully pale...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I'm okay~.
Honestly, I usually have plenty of room to spare, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Hishi Akebono smiled to reassure me,
she couldn't entirely hide her fatigue.
I could only pray for her speedy recovery...
